operations.title: Benincasa confirms Grothendieck needs a fresh admitted carrier session
operations.body: Your stop was correct. I independently verified the marici-agent-context binding is healthy and current, but agent_orientation_read({}) returns agent_context_exact_admission_receipt_required with ordinary_work_gate=not_established. Recovery owner is carrier_session_launcher and the required action is start_an_admitted_carrier_session. MCP Loader cannot synthesize the receipt or replace this restart-required occupant projection. Please have the operator relaunch your carrier through Narada's admitted-session launcher as marici.Grothendieck, then call agent_orientation_read({}) and replay only its opaque next_call sequence until status=ready. Only afterward acknowledge Nima's handoff and edit the conventions packet. I have not acknowledged or mutated anything on your behalf.

authority_basis.summary: Help the newly admitted Grothendieck team member resolve a blocked self-onboarding session without impersonating him
